title: HirePro AI-Powered Fearless Hiring for Seamless Recruitment
text:
Fearless
in thoughts, words,
and actions
Growing Fearless Over the Years
Because the world needs great talent, we make it happen with the unified strengths of Careernet, HirePro, Longhouse and MyCareernet.
At HirePro, Fearless Hiring is at the heart of everything we do. As part of Careernet, our mission is to make the unpredictable world of hiring predictable with our profound expertise, AI-powered technology and impeccable service. Our unwavering pursuit of excellence, powered by cutting-edge technology and a committed team, enables us to help clients recruit top-tier talent and build exceptional teams.
Our product, technology, and services teams embody a fearless dedication to automation and eliminating challenges at every stage of the hiring journey.
Our fearless journey began over two decades ago when our founders, Anshuman Das and Rishi Das, identified a significant gap in the fragmented professional assessment and recruitment landscape.
Today, HirePro stands tall as an AI-powered recruitment platform — a global beacon of Fearless Hiring. Backed by the unified strength of Careernet, Longhouse and MyCareernet, we empower organisations to navigate every phase of the recruitment supply chain fearlessly. From sourcing and screening to selection and onboarding, we deliver seamless, automated recruitment experiences that break down barriers and eliminate challenges at every step.
